correctness.rationale: For n>=4, the exact factorial moments M_(k,r), r=1,2,3, follow by survival of specified singleton lineages. The future-cherry coefficient 2/[3(k-1)] and past-cherry mixed recurrence A_(k-1)=(k-2)A_k/k+M_(k,3)/[k(k-1)] reconstruct the full stage covariance profile with all boundary cases. Independent Exp(binomial(k,2)) waits turn it into the finite sum -2/9. The n=2,3 exceptions have deterministic cherry counts. Standalone exact forward DP for n=2..30 and exhaustive merger-history enumeration for n=4..8 (1,587,600 eight-leaf histories) test every critical step. These are checks, not substitutes for the general proof.

broader_coverage.reasoning: A general joint moment formula involving both topology and length would subsume this result, but no such applicable theorem was identified in the inspected sources. Broad coalescent covariance reviews inspected here list length/time statistics without shape-count cross moments. The uninspected full 2020 article and other historical work remain residual coverage risks. Closest additional abstracts discuss marked-gene minimal clades and total height of cherries; these observables are not the unweighted total cherry number, but source inaccessibility prevents excluding an implicit broader formula.

value.rationale: Cherry counts represent coalescent genealogy shape and total external length controls expected singleton mutation counts; their covariance is a natural, previously uncomputed joint invariant for gene-tree summary statistics. Its exact sample-size independence n>=4, strict stagewise negative profile and unexpectedly slow vanishing standardized correlation are structurally informative beyond marginal moments and not an arbitrary finite slice.
